title: QueryResult
description: What the `notlob query ...` commands print to stdout with `--format json`, each a JSON value (`search`, `children`, `imports`, `imported-by`, `callers`, `callees`, `cites` and `cited-by` print text by default, a line a node). `children`, `imports`, `imported-by`, `callers`, `callees`, `cites`, `cited-by` and `search` print a NodeList (an empty array when there is nothing to list, exit code 0). `resolve` prints a NodeOrNull. `content` prints, with `--format json`, a graph document (name_graph.json): the view started at the address, at `full`; by default it prints the source as text, which is not JSON. All print `null` and exit 1 when the address or label does not resolve. A node here is the name-graph's at `outline` (`Node` has the properties of `GraphNode` in name_graph.json; a test keeps them so), with the `file` that the graph document gives only the root of a view, because an answer stands on its own. With no project, a .lob file that does not parse, or an address collision that stops the graph being built, nothing is printed to stdout, an error goes to stderr, and the exit code is 1.

NodeList.description: An array of nodes, in graph order.

NodeOrNull.description: A node, or null when it does not resolve.

Node.description: One element of a .lob file: a module, a section, a paragraph, a code block, a claim, a test, a symbol, or an external file. An answer never carries a `body`.

address.description: Globally unique machine identifier. Named, as in 'roman/numerals#to_roman', or positional, as in 'roman/numerals#Decoding#prose#1'.

name.description: The node's name, as the author wrote it: a module's title, a heading, a named claim or test, an appendix's title, or a symbol as written in the code. Present on every node that has one; a node with a positional address has none. The address is built from names, not the other way round.

kind.description: What kind of element this node is.

mode.description: When a RUN runs; present on a RUN only. A bare `~run` is `on-invocation`.

declares.description: What a DECLARATION declares; present on a DECLARATION only.

value.description: The value a DECLARATION gives it, when it has one; present on a DECLARATION only.

file.description: The .lob file it is written in, relative to the project root, with '/' separators. Absent for an external file and for a module built on its own.

start_line.description: The line number where it begins in its file; a file's first line is 1.

body.description: The node's own written lines, verbatim, and not what is under it: a heading's body is its line, and a POST_TEXT's is `---`. A SYMBOL and an EXTERNAL have none of their own; but where a view does not show the node that holds a line, the line is in the body of the deepest node it shows that covers it, so a view started at a SYMBOL gives it its lines. The bodies of a file, each placed at its `start_line`, are the file, or, in a view that starts in it, the part of it the start covers.
